title: Rationalization of a continuous finite free integral representation
statement: For a base P, geometric monodromy point p, and finite free valuation-ring module L carrying a jointly continuous representation for its maximal-ideal adic topology, extension of scalars to P.E is finite dimensional and jointly continuous. The canonical tensor unit is injective, its image is an invariant finite free spanning lattice, and the lattice identification intertwines the integral and rational actions. The precise objects and equalities are the displayed Lean statement. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [def-per-lisse-completed-system-data], [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data].

proof.text: Choose a finite integral basis and its scalar extension. The coordinate formula for the tensor unit proves injectivity; its image is free finite and spans, and scalar extension of every action map preserves it.

Integral coordinate functionals are continuous by the uniformizer coset basis. Apply them to the continuous integral action on each basis vector. Finite basis expansion writes the extended joint action as a finite sum of products of continuous matrix coefficients and continuous vector coordinates. This includes the empty basis.

proof_origin.place: Corollary 6.8.5, p.60; explicit component of integral fibre reconstruction

lean.statement:
theorem integral_representation_rationalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (P : Base.{u} l) (p : SfMonodromyPoint P.X)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Integers l P)) [Module.Finite (Integers l P) L]
    [Module.Free (Integers l P) L] (ρ : Representation (Integers l P) p.group L)
    (hc : @Continuous _ _
      (@instTopologicalSpaceProd _ _ inferInstance
        ((Padic.coefficientExtensionMaximalIdeal l P.E).adicModuleTopology L))
      ((Padic.coefficientExtensionMaximalIdeal l P.E).adicModuleTopology L)
      (fun z : p.group × L ↦ ρ z.1 z.2)) :
    ∃ (V : SfContinuousRepresentations l P.E p)
      (e : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Integers l P).subtype).obj L ≅ ModuleCat.of P.E V.obj.V)
      (B : SfInvariantLattice l P.E V) (i : L ≃ₗ[Integers l P] B.submodule),
      Function.Injective ((ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.unit.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
        (Integers l P).subtype).app L) ∧
      (∀ x : L, (i x).val = e.hom
        ((ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.unit.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
          (Integers l P).subtype).app L x)) ∧
      (∀ (g : p.group) (x : L),
        e.hom ((ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.unit.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
          (Integers l P).subtype).app L
          (ρ g x)) = V.obj.ρ g
          (e.hom ((ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.unit.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
          (Integers l P).subtype).app L x)))
